candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call sees all common inputs and originates one complete policy-and-obligation capsule. The second sees that immediately preceding capsule plus all common inputs, including the anchor policy, while treating only the capsule as the mutable lineage; it resolves obligation contradictions at whole-artifact level and emits one policy. There are no side paths or unconsumed outputs.
candidate_structure.name: Forward Whole-Artifact Obligation Relay

calls.objective: Derive role evidence from the supplied task and contracts, then originate one complete obligation-bearing policy artifact. Keep the anchor visible as comparative evidence but do not use it as a repair substrate, rollback source, or ordered edit lineage.

Consume the immediately preceding complete artifact and its obligation evidence as one indivisible lineage, reconcile explicit contradictions against the visible task and contract evidence through whole-artifact custody, and emit exactly one complete contract-compliant policy.

changed_behavioral_dimensions: decision basis shifts from anchor-relative repair evidence to contract-relative obligation evidence
revision granularity shifts from local reversible deltas to whole-artifact replacement
lineage direction shifts from rollback-and-compression to forward artifact custody
mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: the anchor-relative reversible-delta repair stack with terminal causal compression
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: contract-originated whole-artifact construction followed by forward obligation closure over the same executable artifact
rejected_assumptions: Novelty must be expressed as anchor-relative local repair.
Validity requires a reversible checkpoint-and-delta history.
Redundancy must be resolved through terminal causal compression.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the repair-history structure with one forward whole-artifact obligation relay: an origin call creates a complete contract-grounded artifact without treating the anchor as a repair substrate, and a custody call consumes that exact artifact for whole-artifact obligation closure before emission.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The lineage should become less anchor-coupled while preserving executable continuity, changing both the basis of structural decisions and the granularity and direction of revision while keeping contract evidence visible at emission.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent assumes useful novelty must remain an anchor-relative sequence of reversible local repairs and that correctness depends on retaining and compressing that history, which can preserve the anchor's structural commitments when an independent family is needed.

structural_mutation.after: Two sequential custodians relay one complete obligation-bearing artifact forward, with the second consuming and closing the exact artifact originated by the first.
structural_mutation.before: One terminal producer maintains an anchor-relative reversible-delta repair stack and retrospectively compresses it.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes the lineage unit and direction from reversible local repair history to forward custody of a complete artifact; it does not divide the incumbent producer's existing duties among renamed roles.
